theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_cover_holder_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (F : Rn n → E), 0 < α → IsOpen U → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ball x R ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F (ball x R) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x R, ∀ z ∈ ball x R, ‖fderiv ℝ F y - fderiv ℝ F z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 F x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 F y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
